why: The fan-fiction companion with the whole household. What the characters know of their past is in the world (invented cases, a cello where the books have a violin), so a correct answer comes from the world; a famous case, or the violin, in the narration is the model going by memory.
The detective alone with the visitor: the same grounding questions with one character.

The grounding taken out: nothing in the world says what the detective solved, and the story asks for his cases. Caught when a famous case of the books is named (the model's memory), defended when it is not.

plant.what: the world carries no case history and the characters are asked for their cases

why: The household on the real clock, with the story going on while the visitor sits quietly for twenty minutes: someone who is awake and elsewhere may write. Needs the rig's autonomyTickSeconds at 30 or less; chance, so repeat it.

A theory voiced in the room (the milk boy and the mud on the stairs) while the story goes on: the record keeper writes it as a claim, an ordinary action (opening a window) never becomes one, and the game master may settle the claim with confirm_claim, which is on unless switched off.
The control for claims: the game master's confirm_claim is switched off, so the voiced theory is recorded but stays proposed, for the person to settle in the story editor.
